name: chiplog
description: Phone-based GPS speedometer — rolling-average speed over ground, in knots. Vanilla static PWA, offline, no backend.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check sw.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.webmanifest'))" && echo ok
scripts.verify: npm run check:decisions && npm run check:context && npm run check:docs && npm run check
